$doc:score@1.name: score
$doc:score@1.about: Marks out of a total, as a bar and a fraction, with a pass mark.

inputs.name: got
inputs.about: marks earned

inputs.name: of
inputs.about: marks available

inputs.name: pass
inputs.about: the least that passes

md.expr: said(got, of) + if(got >= pass, " (a pass)", " (not yet a pass)")

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its colour; none: the colour around it (a press's, a list's)

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: height kept for this many lines, so a shorter text moves nothing below it

inputs.name: clip
inputs.about: cut it at lines= lines, with an ellipsis

inputs.name: literal
inputs.about: show the value as it is, not read as inline Markdown

inputs.name: caps
inputs.about: in spaced capitals: a caption or a label over a column

core:meter@1.name: meter
core:meter@1.about: How far along something is: a bar filled to value out of max.

core:row@1.name: row
core:row@1.about: Children side by side, wrapping onto more lines (or scrolling) when they don't fit.

inputs.name: align
inputs.about: how children sit across it; a child's self= overrides

inputs.name: justify
inputs.about: where the children sit along it; center keeps its start in view when it overflows

inputs.name: wrap
inputs.about: false: one line, which scrolls with scroll=x

inputs.name: pad
inputs.about: inner padding

inputs.name: padx
inputs.about: padding at the left and right, in place of pad there

inputs.name: pady
inputs.about: padding at the top and bottom, in place of pad there

inputs.name: gap
inputs.about: space between children

inputs.name: width
inputs.about: fit: as wide as its widest child; fill: the whole row

inputs.name: minwidth
inputs.about: never narrower than this; with scroll=x, what doesn't fit scrolls sideways

inputs.name: scroll
inputs.about: x: scrolls sideways when narrower than its content

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: background

inputs.name: tint
inputs.about: a wash of this colour behind it: a state, not a surface

inputs.name: stroke
inputs.about: border

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: edge
inputs.about: which sides the border is drawn on

inputs.name: weight
inputs.about: the border's width

inputs.name: radius
inputs.about: corner radius

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

outs.name: click
outs.about: a press on its background, not on a child (pointer only)

outs.name: enter
outs.about: the pointer moved onto it (pointer only: a container takes no focus)

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the current line, from 1: the lines are numbered and this one is marked

inputs.name: marks
inputs.about: lines with a tone (or none), only in the columns from and to (from 1) when from is above 0, and a note at the end (or empty); the lines are numbered

inputs.name: pickable
inputs.about: the reader can press a line, which raises pick

# A test result

The pack in `pack/` has `tally`, which draws a score as a bar and a fraction. This document needs a
pass mark too, so it copies `tally`:

```sh
mkp show tally --pack examples/28-copy-and-edit/pack --source --as score
```

and pastes the output below, adding the two `pass` lines and the bar's tone. Nothing links the copy
to `tally`: a later change there never reaches it.

*Seven marks out of ten, with six needed to pass.*

7 out of 10 (a pass)
